fields.quoted_span: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
fields.note: DX06 supports a prohibition on automated rent price-fixing, private tenant claims, and a $1,000 per violation and per month penalty. It does not mention sale/licensing/provision, nonpublic competitor data types, injunctive relief, attorney's fees, the tenant's burden of proof, or code enforcement. It also does not state the city-limits scope.
